verify.workflow: Scoped form preparation with exact value maps, input validation, final DOM guards and AND receipt confirmation; native Computer Use handoff remains available.

input_contract.name: Actual product name, 2–80 characters.
input_contract.tagline: A factual, directory-adapted single line of 20–160 characters. Validate the complete supplied line; do not truncate, fabricate, or use generated copy without review.
input_contract.categories[0]: Known product category Writing or Research, explicitly mapped to the current directory slug; exact prepared slugs also accepted. Unknown values block; no label or AI fallback.
input_contract.pricing: Verified product pricing Free or Freemium, explicitly mapped to free/freemium. Unknown values block; pricing describes the product, not the submission plan.
input_contract.email: Authorized contact email for this product; prefer the official public business contact.
input_contract.submitter_name: The separate Product.submitter_name fact, at least two words; do not substitute product name, keywords, AI copy or an invented founder identity.

handoff_checks: Check the task's existing submissions before opening this flow. WarmQuant and WeWorkBuddy were already submitted on 2026-10-09; this recipe does not authorize duplicate intake.
Confirm exactly one intended form exists and select Free listing, intent=listing. Never interact with pin, claim, sponsorship amounts, checkout, or paid subscriptions.
Validate all input constraints and the exact current category/pricing values before filling. A missing or invalid value blocks submission, even if the site has a default pricing selection.
Verify the separately supplied submitter_name contains at least two words and describes the actual authorized submitter, not an assumed founder. Verify the intended contact email.

Leave Company website, name=unlocHp, untouched and empty. Inspect its current value before final submission; if autofill has populated it, stop and diagnose rather than blindly clearing or submitting.

Recheck intent=listing, blank honeypot, all visible values, and button text Submit for review immediately before one final click. Any selector drift, payment lane, CAPTCHA or tool-required agreement confirmation requires handoff.

Observe the actual submission processing, including Sending…, and its resulting navigation to /submit/thanks with Received. and The listing is pending review. Inspect any fieldErrors/error instead of claiming success.

A directly visited generic thanks page, a pre-existing Received message, a click, or field clearing alone is insufficient. Without a confirmed response keep unverified and do not automatically retry. Intake is distinct from approved publication.

native_receipt.heading: Received.
native_receipt.scope: Both product applications were confirmed through native CUA; database persistence and public listing were not independently captured.

limitations: Native WarmQuant and WeWorkBuddy submissions were confirmed before this recipe existed. The recipe, guards and engine changes have only controlled offline regression tests; no live CLI/CDP/extension/Browser Use submission has been performed.

Auto/headless and CDP can read and enforce these DOM guards. The current extension lacks guard/AND inspection and is blocked before any actions; use a supported executor rather than dropping constraints.

Browser Use and Computer Use must return task-bound structured before/after visible observations and actual final guard reads. A free-text success claim is rejected. If hidden values cannot be read, stop for handoff.

The server receipt is a generic publicly reachable page. Acceptance is inferred only after starting on the submission page, passing guards and one final click; a pre-existing receipt blocks the click. The server response body/database row/public approval are not independently verified by this recipe.
BotsTest has no verified fitting Unloc category and its unmapped Robotics/AI Directories inputs are blocked. Do not force it into QA/Testing or Coding Agents.
verify.automated_confirmation_scope: Exact thanks URL AND both receipt texts within one visible main element, absent before the final click. The official public receipt DOM was independently read without submission.
